description: This file implements the OcdmSystem class and related factory functions for managing Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) systems and sessions, including creation, destruction, and querying system information.

classes.name: OcdmSystem
classes.description: Implements the IOcdmSystem interface, managing the lifecycle and properties of an OpenCDM system instance.

classes.name: OcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IOcdmSystem.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new OcdmSystemFactory instance.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IOcdmSystem instance for the specified key system.

methods.name: OcdmSystem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the system handle using the provided key system string.

methods.name: ~OcdmSystem
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the system handle.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the system.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.
